column1: # Models of the harness, one `tool<TAB>role<TAB>slug<TAB>family<TAB>expect` line per entry, in preference order
# within a tool and role. Read by scripts/harness.sh (pick, plan, record, sync, check). Every entry is a native
# subagent of its tool, generated into that tool's agents directory by `scripts/harness.sh sync`: no tool calls
# another tool's CLI. A pick never takes the same independence key twice (tools.tsv: the family, or for Claude Code
# the model). expect: a bash glob, matched without case, that the model id the subagent reports on its `Model:`
# line must match for `record` to accept the launch (`?` stands for a `.` or `-` the tools spell differently).
# After any change: scripts/harness.sh sync, then check, then restart the session before launching a changed agent.
# Claude Code: Anthropic only, by Claude Code's model aliases; independence by model, so the Implementer (opus) is
# never reviewed by opus. No fable rows: on this account a fable subagent runs Opus. haiku is the third model of the
# judgment roles because Anthropic models are all Claude Code has.
# Cursor: slugs from `cursor-agent --list-models`; independence by family.
# OpenCode: slugs from `opencode models` (GitHub Copilot provider); independence by family.
